usdRate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji statistics table 8.8 (daily exchange rates)
usdRate.note: FJD 1 = USD 0.4439, so FJD 2.25 per US dollar.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji statistics table 7.1 (Fiji Bureau of Statistics CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Year-on-year CPI 6.8% in September 2026 (7.6% in August), driven by fuel prices; Trading Economics reports the same figure.

inflation_projection.sourceName: RBF inflation objective (around 3%); RBF Press Release 23/2026 on elevated supply-driven inflation; CPI average 2022-2026
inflation_projection.note: The RBF aims for inflation around 3% and the 2022-2026 average is roughly 3%, so we plan with 3.5% to allow for the import-price shocks seen in 2022 and 2026.

policy_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji, Press Release No. 31/2026

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji statistics table 2.8 (commercial banks' savings deposit rate)
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average savings deposit rate 0.31% in August 2026 (RBF table 2.8).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji statistics table 2.9 (carded time deposit rates)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Carded 3-month rate range across banks 0.05-0.25% in August 2026; midpoint used. Negotiated rates for large deposits run up to 2.69%.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji statistics table 2.9 (carded time deposit rates)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Carded 12-month rate range across banks 0.05-0.25%; midpoint used. Negotiated rates for large deposits run up to 3.55%.

dps_rate.note: Searched RBF rate tables and bank rate pages: Fiji banks do not publish a monthly recurring deposit (DPS-style) product rate.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: RBF table 2.8 shows the weighted average time deposit rate at 2.01% and savings at 0.31% in August 2026; it has no combined average. Figure is for 2024 (older than 2025).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji, Viti Bond 2026-2027 FAQ
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Viti Bond (government retail bond) 5-year coupon 3.00% (7-year 3.50%, 10-year 4.00%); FJD 1,000 to 200,000 per fiscal year; interest paid quarterly.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji statistics table 4.1 (Treasury bill 91-day rate)
tbill_91d_rate.note: 91-day Treasury bill tender rate 0.25% in August 2026; the 30 September 2026 government yield curve shows 0.30% at 3 months.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji government yield curve, 30 September 2026

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji government yield curve, 30 September 2026

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Fiji Revenue and Customs Service, Resident Interest Withholding Tax
tax_bank_interest.note: 10% final withholding tax; individuals with gross income up to FJD 30,000 and eligible pensioners can apply for exemption.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Fiji, Viti Bond 2026-2027 FAQ
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest on Viti Bonds is exempt from income tax.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Searched RBF, IMF and World Bank material: no deposit insurance scheme for Fiji was found, and no source stating its absence.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap on card interest was found; the only published card rate seen was one commercial bank's posted rate, which this dataset does not cite (company page). RBF table 2.8 gives no card rate.

equity_return_low.note: Low case near the tax-free Viti Bond rate, since the local exchange is small and illiquid.

equity_return_base.note: Safe tax-free rate of 3% plus a 3.5-point premium; the local market is thin, so the premium is kept below 4 points.

equity_return_high.note: High case if dividend yields and local listed-company growth hold up as in recent years.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (FJD per USD broadly stable at 2.1-2.3 for a decade)
gold_return_low.note: Low case for gold in FJD: weak dollar gold price and a stable peg-basket currency.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (FJD per USD broadly stable at 2.1-2.3 for a decade)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus little expected FJD depreciation under the basket peg.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (FJD per USD broadly stable at 2.1-2.3 for a decade)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and some FJD weakening.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: RBF carded 12-month deposit rate after 10% RIWT
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: carded 1-year deposit of about 0.15% less 10% withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of tax-free Viti Bonds (3%) and short government paper or deposits (0.3-1.25%).

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: all in tax-free 5-year Viti Bonds at 3%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Searched RBF insurance annual reports and news: no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio is published.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold in Fiji, but no published per-1,000 premium rates by age were found; insurers quote individually.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Searched for private hospital surgery costs in Suva: no published typical bill found.

health_premium_table.note: The only premium table found was one insurer's own brochure, which this dataset does not cite (company source); no regulator or industry-wide premium guide was found.

oop_health_share.note: Figure is for 2023 (older than 2025); latest World Bank value.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: RBF CPI table 7.1; headline CPI average
goal_inflation_health.note: No separate medical CPI is published in the RBF table, so we plan with headline projection plus one point for private medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: RBF CPI table 7.1; headline CPI average
goal_inflation_education.note: No separate education CPI is published in the RBF table, so we plan with headline projection plus half a point.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 67.8 for 2026. World Bank figure is for 2024 (older than 2025).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there). Values are the UN WPP 2024 estimates for calendar 2026 (mid-year date used).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 9.97 (2025, World Bank), 12.2 (2040) and 20.4 (2065, populationpyramid.net/fiji/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Fiji Sun: FNPF retirement withdrawal age stays at 55
retirement_age_default.note: FNPF entitlement (full withdrawal) age is 55 for men and women, confirmed by the Finance Minister on 23 August 2025; there is no statutory private-sector retirement age. Applies equally to people born after 1975.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Fiji Times: civil service retirement age revised to 60
retirement_age_government.note: Civil Service (General) (Amendment) Regulations 2023: retirement at 60, optional at 55; extensions to 62 for scarce-skill posts. Source is from January 2023 (older than 2025); no later change was found.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short government paper and deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the 1-year government yield, the best safe 1-year rate available.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: laddered tax-free Viti Bonds at 3%.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: FNPF credited 9.5% for 2026 (Fiji Sun, 26 June 2026); safe rates 1-4%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if FNPF crediting rates fall back toward bond yields.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: FNPF credited 9.5% for 2026 (Fiji Sun, 26 June 2026); safe rates 1-4%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case well below the recent 9.5% FNPF credit, allowing for a balanced mix and lower future credits.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: FNPF credited 9.5% for 2026 (Fiji Sun, 26 June 2026); safe rates 1-4%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case near recent FNPF credited rates.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Fiji Times: 2023-2024 Budget social welfare allowance increases
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social Pension Scheme: FJD 115 a month at 65-69 and FJD 125 at 70+, effective August 2023 (announced 30 June 2023). Source is older than 2025: a later increase was reported but its amount could not be confirmed from a source read in this pass.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Fijivillage: Social Pension Scheme eligibility clarified by the Ministry
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Ministry (26 October 2026): Fiji citizens aged 65 and over qualify if they do not receive an FNPF pension or other qualifying superannuation (a pension test, recorded as meansTested); the Ministry said asset tests belong to the separate Family Assistance Scheme. Higher rate from 70. 59,918 recipients in 2025-26.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment for private employees was found (retirement savings run through FNPF), but no source read in this pass states its absence, so it is not marked absent.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Fiji Sun: FNPF retirement withdrawal age stays at 55
public_pension_scheme.note: FNPF is a defined-contribution provident fund, not an indexed pension: lump sum or pension from the entitlement age of 55 (Fiji Sun, 23 August 2025). Members' balances were credited 9.5% for 2026 (Fiji Sun, 26 June 2026).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product is published by Fiji banks.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold by the RBF for the Government; 5, 7 and 10 years; tax-free interest.

tbill_91d.note: Issued by tender through the RBF; mainly bought by institutions.

equity_fund.note: Locally managed unit trusts invest in shares on the small local exchange and fixed income.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold; mainly sold as jewellery.

insuranceComplaints.name: Reserve Bank of Fiji complaints management

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social Pension Scheme, Ministry of Women, Children and Social Protection

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health and Medical Services (public hospitals)
